headline: Chest-high SE on a cross-on wind — surfable but not worth the drive.
today: Good angle and up to 3.2ft on the bigger sets, but the S/SW is cross-on start to finish so it's bumpy and disorganized. If you're already out there it'll work on a shortboard around the tides, but nothing here justifies the 2.5 hours from Rockaway today.

daysToWatch.note: 1.2 to 1.6ft ESE with W cross-off cleaning it up. Fun and clean but small — local-only quality.
Size is there to 2.7ft but the angle's gone marginal E and it's cross-off over junk. Don't get fooled by the height.
